Yōkai

The F-Droid repository for Yōkai and Yōkai Nightly, a free and open source manga reader for Android

Currently it serves 2 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://4noonx.github.io/animan-repo/fdroid/repo
